- 2026-11-17 — Phase 10, I1 task 3: shared fixes, off by default. `matchLines(bill, msn, { tolerant })` with the rungs `code_amount` and `amount_order` (tolerant runs one rung over every line before the next, so a weaker rung never takes a notice line a stronger one would pair; the regular order is unchanged); `findDiscrepancies({ tolerant })` skips the duplicate check for a blank code or date and calls a culprit paired without code and date "possible". Always on: a `code_date` pair needs a non-blank code and date, and an empty description matches nothing (no fixture has either). `CaseFacts.noticeMaxCents` optional, `extraCents`, `formatDate` leaves a non-ISO string alone, `ClaimsConnector.kind` gains `dropped_document`. Verified: 184 unit tests (the existing cases untouched), typecheck (Fable agent).

- 2026-11-17 — Phase 10, I1 task 4: pipeline, off by default. `PipelineOpts.tolerant` (a missing notice goes on to `compareAndFinish(run, bill, null)`, a `requiresReview` finding does not park, the option reaches `findDiscrepancies`; a connector that is down still parks). `compareAndFinish`, `noticeSummary` and `factsFor` take a null notice. `PipelineDeps.drafts` replaces the two templates when given and each letter is checked against the facts it returns. Not settled by the runbook, chosen here: a tolerant or `drafts` run words three step summaries neutrally ("No notice to compare with", "The lines could not all be checked against a notice", "Letters ready: n") so no stored step says the bill agrees with a notice that was never read; private mode discards them anyway. Verified: 189 unit tests (the existing cases untouched), typecheck (Fable agent).

- 2026-11-17 — Phase 10, I1 task 6: fixtures, readers, bounds. Seven new pages under `fixtures/documents/html/` (covered: solid boxes over the name and account number; partly: a marker stroke over the name, so every file has its own hash; amount covered) and their PNGs, `bill-main-exif.jpg` (invented GPS, open ocean), `fixtures/private/reads.json` and `demo-policy.json`, all written by `scripts/make-fixture-images.mjs`; the eight indexed PNGs and `index.json` came out byte-identical. `privateRead.ts` (`FixturePrivateReader`, `StubPrivateReader`, `DemoOnly`, `DEMO_SET`, `demoHashes`, `selectPrivateReader`), `scrub.ts` (`boundRead`, `scrub`). Chosen here where the runbook and the feature document differ: a raw read in `reads.json` carries amounts as printed (`"$466.00"`), not integer cents, because §5 lets `boundRead` keep an amount only when it is printed with two decimals; `boundRead(read, page, today)` gives the `PrivateRead` with cents. The synthetic pages print no address and no Medicare number, so none is covered. A read of a kind we do not know, or that is not an object, is `other`, never `unreadable`. The §12 case "a policy with a CCN, a phone and a URL reaches the outcome unchanged" needs `runStateless` and waits for task 9. Verified: 228 unit tests, typecheck (Fable agent).

- 2026-11-17 — Phase 10, I1 task 7: `src/lib/private/join.ts` (`join`, `coverageOf`, `assume`, `outcomeOf`) and `ASSUMPTIONS` plus `COVERAGE_WORDS` in `copy.ts`; the feature document §6 gained three short lists (when a rule applies, the statements the table does not quote, "If wrong"). Chosen here, none settled by the runbook: every left-out file is counted (two blurry files are two, never folded as equal reads); bill pages whose hospital names differ are two bills, like differing amounts or statement dates; a page that numbers its lines from 1 again continues the count; a notice line also needs its billed amount (the joined shape has no blank for it); with no maximum of its own, a bill with no lines or a covered charge is `unmatched`; one income that cannot be made yearly leaves the yearly figure null; a dropped notice line adds `line_patient` to `covered`. `coverageOf`: a policy that covers insured patients is `covered` and one that does not say is `not_stated` whether or not a statement was dropped; `insurance_unknown` is only a policy that excludes insured patients with no statement dropped. `assume`, following mocks PM3a to PM3c: the household guess is listed only when it is in a figure, `guideline_region` only for Alaska and Hawaii, guesses before plain lines. Open for tasks 8, 9 and 11: row T1 says "Assumed on household size only" while §2a counts `coverage_type` as a guess (PM3a shows 2); the mock sentence "If two to four people live there, the policy lists free care." is in no document; `Joined` keeps no notice kind when the notice could not be used. Verified: 265 unit tests, typecheck (Fable agent).
